import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
p='/workspace/data_inspect/JD_AgeRelated_CpG_noMT_Final.csv'
df=pd.read_csv(p, dtype={'Chromosome':str})
print(df.shape)
print(df.columns.tolist())
print('chr dtype', df['Chromosome'].dtype)
print('unique chrom in data sorted?', df['Chromosome'].unique()[:30])
print('n unique Pos total', df['Pos'].nunique())
print('n unique chrom', df['Chromosome'].nunique())
print('rows per pos stats', df.groupby('Pos').size().describe())
print('methyl range', df['MethylationPercentage'].min(), df['MethylationPercentage'].max())
print('Dage na?', df['Dage'].isna().sum())
print('Pos format head', df['Pos'].head(3).tolist())
# Determine whether a pos can map to multiple chrom
print('pos vs chrom mismatches', df.groupby('Pos')['Chromosome'].nunique().gt(1).sum())
# Filter strict
f=df[(df['MethylationPercentage']>90)|(df['MethylationPercentage']<10)]
print('filtered rows', len(f), 'unique pos', f['Pos'].nunique(), 'chroms', f['Chromosome'].nunique())
lengths=pd.read_csv('/workspace/data_inspect/JD_Chromosome_Length.csv', dtype={'Chromosome':str})
print('length file chroms', lengths['Chromosome'].tolist())
counts=f.drop_duplicates('Pos').groupby('Chromosome').size()
counts=counts.to_frame('count')
merged=counts.merge(lengths, left_index=True, right_on='Chromosome', how='left')
print('missing length chroms', merged[merged['Length'].isna()])
merged['density']=merged['count']/merged['Length']
print(merged.head(20))
print('mean density', merged['density'].mean())
print('n chroms included', len(merged))
print('sum count', merged['count'].sum())
print('unique pos filtered expected', f['Pos'].nunique())
# save expected maybe not final

import csv, collections, math, os
p='/workspace/data_inspect/JD_AgeRelated_CpG_noMT_Final.csv'
rows=[]; pos_chr={}; pos_rows=collections.Counter(); chr_set=set(); meth=[]
with open(p, newline='', encoding='utf-8-sig') as f:
 r=csv.DictReader(f)
 for row in r:
  pos=row['Pos']; chr=row['Chromosome']; methv=float(row['MethylationPercentage'])
  rows.append((pos,chr,methv))
  pos_chr[pos]=chr
  pos_rows[pos]+=1
  chr_set.add(chr)
  meth.append(methv)
print('rows',len(rows),'unique pos',len(pos_chr),'chroms',len(chr_set),'meth minmax',min(meth),max(meth))
print('duplicate pos to multiple chr', sum(1 for p in pos_chr if len(set(c for pos,c,m in rows if pos==p))>1))
# filtered
filtered=[]; unique=set()
for pos,chr,m in rows:
 if m>90 or m<10:
  filtered.append((pos,chr,m)); unique.add(pos)
print('filtered rows',len(filtered),'unique filtered pos',len(unique))
lengths={}
with open('/workspace/data_inspect/JD_Chromosome_Length.csv', newline='', encoding='utf-8-sig') as f:
 for row in csv.DictReader(f):
  lengths[row['Chromosome']]=int(row['Length'])
print('length chroms', list(lengths.items())[:5], 'n',len(lengths))
# unique positions grouped chr (need one pos->chr mapping from filtered)
chr_unique_pos=collections.defaultdict(set)
for pos,chr,m in filtered:
 chr_unique_pos[chr].add(pos)
counts={c:len(v) for c,v in chr_unique_pos.items()}
print('counts by chr:')
for c in sorted(counts, key=lambda x: (int(x) if x.isdigit() else 999, x)):
 print(c, counts[c], lengths.get(c))
dens=[]
for c,n in counts.items():
 if c not in lengths:
  print('missing length',c)
 else:
  d=n/lengths[c]; dens.append(d)
print('n included',len(dens),'sum counts',sum(counts.values()))
print('mean density (local check)', sum(dens)/len(dens) if dens else None)
print('first densities')
for c in sorted(counts, key=lambda x: (int(x) if x.isdigit() else 999, x)):
 print(c, counts[c]/lengths[c] if c in lengths else None)
PY"
